build.buildCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@inkwell/web

deploy.startCommand: cp -r apps/web/public apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/ && cp -r apps/web/.next/static apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next/ && node apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/server.js
